events.what_it_is: A public NYFW pop-up styled like a New York stoop, with beauty and hair refresh stations, a photo booth, legwear displays and on-site customization.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle/beauty touch-ups and the photo booth are advertised as free. Hand embroidery is free only with purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Embroidery is not a no-purchase freebie: current event listings say it is complimentary with purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs. Other promotional items and partner sampling may be inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street in SoHo. No advance RSVP or host approval requirement is stated in the current listings.

occurrences.details: Public walk-in pop-up; embroidery requires purchase of eligible knee highs.
